_comment: Procedural table for Items. weaponSkill keys and damageMin/damageMax are NOT authored here -- lib/proceduralGenerators.js rolls those from lib/itemFormulas.js's WEAPON_ROLL_RANGES/clampDamageRange at generation time, per procedural_generation_scope_proposal.md #4. Same for armor: effectorTierRange picks a tier, computeArmorDR() derives the DR number. rarityWeights is a per-row weighted pool the generator uses to pick THIS item's rarity; the top-level 'weight' on each row controls how often that row is picked at all relative to its siblings.

weapons.flavorTemplate: A length of construction rebar bent into a crude head, {condition}.
A firefighter's axe, {condition}, still bearing a faded department decal.
A demolition sledgehammer re-gripped for combat, head {condition}.
A slab cut from an I-beam and ground down to an edge, {condition}.
A chain welded to a chunk of engine block, {condition}, swings like it means it.
A road crew's post-driver, cut down and rebalanced, {condition}.
A ship's anchor chain wound around a steel core, {condition}, heavier than it looks.
A retractable-blade utility knife, {condition}, kept honed out of habit.
A cook's cleaver, {condition}, still smelling faintly of the last kitchen it left.
A sharpened length of scrap wrapped in tape for grip, {condition}.
A surgical bone saw, {condition}, teeth still disturbingly clean.
A brass letter opener filed down to a real point, {condition}.
A climber's ice pick, {condition}, still gripping fine in a gloved hand.
A thin, flexible filet knife, {condition}, built for finding the gap between things.
Rebar lashed to a mop handle, {condition}, point filed narrow.
A collapsible riot baton wired to stay locked open, {condition}.
A dock worker's boat hook, {condition}, hook end reground into a point.
A farm pitchfork, {condition}, tines wired together into one point.
An extendable window-washing pole with a blade lashed to the end, {condition}.
An axe head and a hook welded to a scaffolding pole, {condition}.
Hand-wrapped cloth reinforced with washers, {condition}.
A harness-mounted grapple claw, {condition}, meant for climbing before it was repurposed.
Bent rebar shaped into a knuckle-duster, {condition}.
A leather gauntlet with a spring-loaded striking plate, {condition}, and a hair trigger.
Work gloves with lead shot sewn into the knuckles, {condition}.
A single-shot pistol salvaged from a display case, {condition}.
A hunting rifle with the stock cut down for close quarters, {condition}.
A framing nail gun rewired to fire full-auto, {condition}, still smells of compressed air.
A revolver with a cylinder from a different model entirely, {condition}, works anyway.
A flare gun with the barrel bored out to take real rounds, {condition}.
A recurve bow strung with braided cable, {condition}.
A crossbow built from plumbing pipe and a car-door spring, {condition}.
A diver's speargun, {condition}, band replaced twice over.
A slingshot with a steel forked frame, {condition}, bands doubled up.
A hunting compound bow, {condition}, cams still tuned true.
A hand-wound induction coil, {condition}, that hums when gripped.
A repurposed antenna rig, {condition}, tuned to something that isn't radio.
A rubber-hafted baton with a scavenged capacitor bank inside, {condition}.
A tuning-fork-shaped rig that arcs between its prongs, {condition}.
A cracked bell rewired with a striker and a battery pack, {condition}.

armor.flavorTemplate: A quilted undersuit, {condition}, worn as a base layer under heavier gear.
A police-issue riot vest, {condition}, plates visibly reinforced with scrap.
A butcher's chainmail apron, {condition}, repurposed as torso armor.
License plates riveted together into a crude breastplate, {condition}.
A bomb-disposal vest with the bulkiest plates stripped for mobility, {condition}.
A welder's helmet with the visor swapped for scavenged plexiglass, {condition}.
A full-face riot helmet, {condition}, visor scratched nearly opaque.
Hockey shin guards strapped over work pants, {condition}.
Sheet-metal bracers riveted to leather straps, {condition}.

consumables.name: Trauma Kit
consumables.effect: Restores a moderate amount of health and clears one Bleed stack.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A resealed trauma kit, {condition}, gauze still sterile-wrapped.

consumables.name: Stim Injector
consumables.effect: Grants a burst of Energy and a small Accuracy boost for the rest of the encounter.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A spring-loaded injector, {condition}, label long since worn off.

consumables.name: Smoke Canister
consumables.effect: Fills an area with smoke, reducing enemy Accuracy against anyone inside it.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A dented smoke canister, {condition}, pin still true.

consumables.name: Adrenal Booster
consumables.effect: Grants one extra action this turn, at the cost of Sanity next turn.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A jury-rigged adrenal booster, {condition}, definitely not medical-grade.

consumables.name: Field Ration
consumables.effect: Restores a small amount of Sanity and staves off exhaustion for the next scene.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A foil-wrapped ration bar, {condition}, edible despite appearances.

consumables.name: Antidote Vial
consumables.effect: Clears one Poison or Corruption stack.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A cloudy vial labeled by hand, {condition}, contents unnervingly consistent.

consumables.name: Flashbang (improvised)
consumables.effect: Stuns enemies in a small area for one turn.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A soda can packed with flash powder, {condition}, fuse taped on.

consumables.name: Nerve Tonic
consumables.effect: Clears one Fear or Panic status and grants brief Fate resistance.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A bitter tonic in a reused bottle, {condition}, tastes like copper.

consumables.name: Repair Patch
consumables.effect: Restores a chunk of a broken machine's or ally's shield/armor durability.
consumables.flavorTemplate: An adhesive repair patch, {condition}, edges curling slightly.

consumables.name: Focus Draught
consumables.effect: Grants a Knowledge-based skill check bonus for the rest of the scene.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A small vial of something viscous and faintly luminous, {condition}.

questItems.name: Sealed Manifest
questItems.flavorTemplate: A wax-sealed shipping manifest, {condition}, listing cargo that officially never existed.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whoever sealed this wanted it to survive them -- the wax seal alone is worth more than the paper it's protecting.

questItems.name: Keyed Data Chit
questItems.flavorTemplate: A palm-sized data chit, {condition}, keyed to a lock nobody's found yet.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}, still warm from whatever it was last plugged into. Someone is going to want this back.

questItems.name: Faded Photograph
questItems.flavorTemplate: A photograph, {condition}, of people who don't look like they knew what was coming.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Tucked away at {locationLine}. Nothing written on the back -- whoever kept it assumed they'd remember.

questItems.name: Broken Locket
questItems.flavorTemplate: A locket with the hinge snapped, {condition}, hinge repaired at least once before that.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Pulled from the wreckage at {locationLine}. It was worth fixing once. Someone thought it was worth carrying even broken.

questItems.name: Corporate Access Badge
questItems.flavorTemplate: A laminated badge, {condition}, photo scratched off but the clearance level still legible.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. The clearance level printed on it opens doors that shouldn't still be powered.

questItems.name: Hand-Drawn Map Fragment
questItems.flavorTemplate: A torn corner of a hand-drawn map, {condition}, marked with symbols that match nothing official.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. It's only a fragment -- whatever the rest of the map showed, this piece alone raises more questions than it answers.

questItems.name: Signal Beacon (dead)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A handheld beacon, {condition}, battery long dead but the antenna still extended.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Somebody was trying to call for help, or call something in -- there's no way to tell from the beacon alone.

questItems.name: Ledger Page
questItems.flavorTemplate: A single ledger page, {condition}, columns of names and numbers in a cramped hand.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Torn loose at {locationLine}. Whatever this page was tracking, somebody didn't want the rest of the ledger found alongside it.

carrying a faint chemical smell that never fully airs out
notched along the edge from hard use
gripped smooth in exactly the shape of someone's hand

Uncommon.value: Deals +1 damage against the Bleed status.
Grants +5% accuracy on the first attack each combat.
Recovers a small amount of Energy on a critical hit.

Rare.value: Deals bonus damage against enemies already suffering a status effect.
On a critical hit, applies a second, weaker instance of its status.
+10% accuracy and +5% crit chance while wielded.
Reduces the AP cost of the wielder's first ability each combat by 1.

Legendary.value: Once per combat, the next attack made with this cannot miss.
Damage scales with the wielder's missing health -- the worse things look, the harder it hits.
Applies its status on every hit, not just criticals, for the rest of the encounter after the first kill.
